name: web_research
description: Look up a question on free public sources: web (DuckDuckGo and Wikipedia), Reddit, Google News, Open-Meteo weather, and Open Library books. Use this when the user needs current information, news, weather, or books. Do not invent sources.

q.description: Search text. A question or place name, not a URL.

sources.description: Optional subset: web, reddit, news, weather, books. Omit to search all of them.
